ex_vivo_detail: Serum stability (half-life) assays: SP, LIPO-SP and HDL-SP incubated at 37 C for 0-72 h in normal human blood serum (Sigma-Aldrich; IRB-approved, Yonsei University 201704-BR-928-01) and in diabetic rat serum (n = 4). Serum NEP activity was also compared in normal versus diabetic animal serum. Per protocol these serum-stability assays are classified ex vivo, not in vitro.

notes: Only half-life is reported; no Cmax, Tmax, AUC or clearance values appear in the body. The in vivo PK dose (2 ug per mouse) differs from the efficacy dose (2.5 nmol/kg). Group size for the in vivo degradation-kinetics arm is not stated. The ex vivo assay used rat serum but no rat was dosed in vivo, so rat is not listed under in_vivo_species. The half-lives quoted in RESULTS 3.2 (117 h human serum, 30 h diabetic rat serum, 60 h in vivo) differ slightly from the abstract's fold-change figures; only the body values were used. Several body paragraphs in the source file were truncated at 2000 characters.
